Native-safe substitutions: no DOM/Tailwind/lucide/Recharts/Leaflet/clsx imports; React Native primitives (ScrollView/View/Pressable/Animated/Easing/ActivityIndicator/AccessibilityInfo/StyleSheet) + native parity components (AppText, EmptyState, ErrorBoundary, GlassPanel, RadialGauge, StatCard) + theme tokens. Charts: the native @/components/charts recharts barrel only renders 'unavailable' placeholders, so a real native SeriesBarChart (proportional View bars in a horizontal ScrollView with a y-axis, an optional fixed [yMin,yMax] domain, per-row colours via colorFor, dashed reference lines, and an optional legend) is built instead, mirroring the TrueCostPage/BatteryDegradationPage precedent; the score-trend line chart degrades to a grouped bar chart, and the recharts hover tooltip + ChartContainer export + chart annotations are browser/SVG-only and unavailable on native. RangePicker: the web calendar popover degrades to a preset dropdown driving the same {start,end} ISO state. The table degrades to stacked row cards keeping all column values. State names (), API paths (/drives/score, /drives via useDriveScore/useDrives), the scoreDrive algorithm, unit handling (SI read straight from the API, converted only at the display boundary with distance 'km' / speed 'km/h' defaults), and all driveScore.* / help.* / common.* i18n keys + English copy + interpolation are preserved.
Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck (pass); npm run lint -- --quiet (pass); npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles (pass).
